summary: Rhinebeck Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing the results of a subscription offering in connection with its mutual-to-stock conversion. The offering was oversubscribed by eligible depositors, so no other priority groups will be filled. The ESOP will purchase up to 4% of shares sold on the open market after closing. The filing provides no specific price per share or premium. This is a routine regulatory update on a conversion and stock offering, not a special situation event.
